lines.zh: 警惕地走着，随时准备战斗。
目光如炬，搜寻着敌人的踪迹。
脚步声在空旷之地回荡。
lines.en: His footsteps echo in the open.
He checks the magazine of his rifle.

lines.zh: 他压低身子沿断墙前行
lines.en: He keeps low along the broken wall.

lines.zh: 他踩着瓦砾，尽量不发声
lines.en: He steps over rubble, staying quiet.
He signals the squad to follow.
Scans the area, looking for danger.

lines.zh: 长矛靠在墙上，低头沉思。
lines.en: spear against the wall, head bowed in thought.
He leans on the ruins and takes a drag.

lines.zh: 他把头盔摘下来擦了擦
lines.en: He takes off his helmet and wipes it.

lines.zh: 他翻着半本潮湿的地图
lines.en: He leafs through a damp, half-ruined map.
He counts what ammunition is left.

lines.zh: 我这把枪的子弹不多了。
lines.en: I haven't many rounds left in this gun.

lines.zh: 紧盯着玩家，不放过一丝动静。
lines.en: Fixes eyes on you, watching for movement.

lines.zh: 警惕地环视，寻找玩家踪迹。
快速转向玩家，准备战斗。
lines.en: Rapidly turns towards you, ready to fight.
The muzzle is up — hold still.

lines.zh: 快速拔出长剑，准备战斗。
lines.en: Quickly draws sword, ready to fight.
He raises a hand for you to stay still.
He watches you over his sights.
He moves his hand slowly to his gun.
He quietly asks for the password.

lines.zh: 我的身体受伤了，好难受！

lines.en: I need a doctor, I'm hurt!

lines.zh: 我需要休息，身体受伤了！
lines.en: I need to rest, I'm injured!

lines.zh: 我的身体受了伤，快点帮我！

lines.en: I hurt my leg, walking hurts!

lines.zh: 我来帮助你，但别想占我便宜。
lines.en: I'll help you, but don't try to take advantage of me.

lines.zh: 看看我的剑，你就知道我有多强。
lines.en: Look at my sword, and you'll know how strong I am.

lines.zh: 我能保护你，但不要惹我。
lines.en: I can protect you, but don't provoke me.

lines.zh: 你是我的兄弟，跟我一起战斗。
lines.en: You're my brother, fight with me.

lines.zh: 食物不能让我的剑失去锋芒。
枪里的子弹还够分你一颗。
lines.en: I have a bullet spare for you.

lines.zh: 你得付出代价，才能得到我的信任。
lines.en: You'll have to earn my trust.

lines.zh: 只有真正的勇士才配得上我的友谊。
lines.en: Only true warriors deserve my friendship.
Think twice before standing in front of my rifle.
My body is hard, don't touch it!
Let me through; I'm relieving the watch.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，现在退开！
lines.en: You're blocking my path, move away!

lines.zh: 你挡着巷口，我看不见它们。
lines.en: You block the alley mouth; I can't see them.
Back off, or I'll get angry.
Make way, or I'll attack you!
Finding my mate is not easy.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是我生命的一部分。
lines.en: My partner is a part of my life.

lines.zh: 她守夜时，我替她压子弹。
lines.en: While she keeps watch, I load her magazines.

lines.zh: 我愿意为她战斗到最后一刻。
lines.en: I'll fight to the last moment for her.
She's the only one in my heart.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣是我们的使命。
lines.en: Finding a partner is our mission.

lines.zh: 我们的爱情比生命更重要。
lines.en: Our love is more important than life.
Pick up arrow, ready to shoot.
Pick up axe, ready to fight.
Pick up torch, light the way.
Stare at enemy, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 巷子里那道影子，我盯住了。
lines.en: That shadow in the alley is mine now.

lines.zh: 发现敌人，战斗意识提高。

lines.en: Safety's off; you have three seconds.
My sights rest on your chest; hold still.

lines.zh: 枪口抬起来，别浪费子弹。

lines.en: He grits his teeth and lowers the muzzle.
Hack the enemy with an axe!
Chop the enemy with an axe!
Armed squad on site — stand still.
A patrol turns the street corner.

lines.zh: 哎呀，这伤口可真疼，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Ouch, that really hurts! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 从二楼摔下来，肋骨先着地。
lines.en: I fell from the second floor and landed on my ribs.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，需要医疗，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hurt, I need help! — and the drown makes it worse.
I got hurt by an explosion, it hurts!

lines.zh: 我的身体受伤了，好难受，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm injured, this hurts — and the projectile makes it worse.
I got hurt by magic, it hurts!

lines.zh: 别打我，我受伤了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Don't hit me, I'm hurt! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷劈在枪管上，我手都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my barrel and numbed my hands.

lines.zh: 伤口流血了，好痛，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: It's bleeding, it hurts! — and the void makes it worse.
